observations: Photos 0-2 show stacks of wooden pallets in an outdoor yard with debris, a truck and parked cars in the background.
Several pallet blocks in photos 1 and 2 are stamped with an oval 'EPAL' mark, a European pallet standard mark, plus some other stamped codes ('IPPC', 'FPAL' style marks).
Pallets appear to be standard four-way or two-way block pallets, tan/light wood colour, some look fairly clean and new-ish, others show dirt and staining.
Photo 3 shows a different wooden structure - a flat panel made of slats with a diagonal brace, held up by two hands - this looks like a crate side/panel, not a flat pallet.
No measuring tape, ruler or size reference is shown in any photo.
No photo shows a close-up of the underside boards, nail condition, or any rot/cracks on individual pallets.
No quantity count or signage stating how many units are for sale.

claims.evidence: EPAL-style oval stamps visible on blocks in photo 1 and photo 2 are consistent with European-origin pallets, but a stamp alone does not confirm the pallets were actually imported rather than locally stamped/reused, and the wood grade cannot be judged from these shots.

risks.risk: Overall structural condition (cracked boards, missing/loose boards, hidden rot) not visible in stacked wide shots
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of 2-3 individual pallets from top, bottom and side, showing board edges and joints
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worn stock, not premium condition

risks.risk: Quantity being sold is not stated or shown with a count
risks.proof: A photo with the pallets laid out separately and counted, or seller's written count
risks.if_unproven: priced per single unit, not as a bulk lot

risks.risk: Photo 3 appears to show a different item (a crate panel, not a flat pallet) possibly mixed into the same lot
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of what is in photo 3 and whether it is part of this listing
risks.if_unproven: excluded from the pallet valuation, treated as unidentified scrap wood

risks.risk: Dimensions (standard Euro 1200x800mm vs other sizes) cannot be confirmed without a scale reference
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against a pallet edge
risks.if_unproven: priced as smaller/non-standard size, the conservative assumption

risks.risk: Nails, staples or protruding metal fasteners pose a safety/usability issue not visible in these distances
risks.proof: Close-up of pallet corners and nail heads
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing rework before reuse

proof_requests: Close-up shots of 2-3 individual pallets (top, bottom, sides) showing board condition and joints
A clear count of how many pallets are included in this sale
Confirmation of what the item in photo 3 is and whether it belongs to this listing
A photo with a tape measure or known-size object against a pallet for scale
response.reason: The photos clearly show wooden pallets, a recognizable type of good that does not need a model number, so they can be priced at worst-case used condition with unverified size and count.
